title: go-format telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the go-format hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "go-format". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the checked file, relative to the consuming repo root.

findings.description: Syntax diagnostics gofmt reported instead of reformatting (gofmt parses before writing, so a syntax error leaves the file untouched). Empty array = clean or successfully reformatted.
